description: Curated highlights for the README. Every link must name a contribution id in contributions.jsonl; `claim` says which fact the link supports and is checked by tests (authored-merged | authored | reviewer). Wording describes what the PR title states, not impact.

items.text: Added the Transfer Verifier mechanism to the Guardian node, integrated it into the Ethereum watcher, and wrote its whitepaper.
Extended Governor flow cancel with a configurable allow-list of chain ID pairs, and added the Notary package for verifying message publications.
Added fuzzing and overflow checks for TrimmedAmount in the Solana program, and wrote INVARIANTS.md to support security assessments.
